_note: Descriptions are starter drafts. Verify each against the project's own site before launch; practical notes are left empty on purpose because only a human writes them.

entities.name: Backstage
entities.description: Open-source framework for building a developer portal: software catalog, templates and a plugin system. You assemble and operate it yourself.

entities.name: Roadie
entities.description: Hosted, managed Backstage. Same catalog and plugin model without running Backstage yourself.

entities.name: Port
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal built around a configurable data model, self-service actions and scorecards.

entities.name: Cortex
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal that leads with service ownership, scorecards and standards enforcement.

entities.name: OpsLevel
entities.description: Commercial internal developer portal centred on a service catalog, maturity scorecards and campaigns to drive fixes across services.

entities.name: Humanitec Platform Orchestrator
entities.description: Commercial platform orchestrator that generates app and infrastructure configuration from a workload spec. Humanitec also runs PlatformEngineering.org.

entities.name: Argo CD
entities.description: GitOps continuous delivery controller for Kubernetes: reconciles cluster state to what is declared in Git.

entities.name: Flux
entities.description: GitOps toolkit for Kubernetes: a set of controllers that keep clusters in sync with Git, OCI and Helm sources.

entities.name: Crossplane
entities.description: Kubernetes-based control plane for provisioning and composing cloud infrastructure behind your own platform APIs.

entities.name: Kyverno
entities.description: Kubernetes-native policy engine: validate, mutate and generate resources, and verify image signatures, using policies written as YAML.

entities.name: Kubernetes MCP Server
entities.description: MCP server that exposes Kubernetes and OpenShift cluster operations to AI agents.

entities.name: Terraform MCP Server
entities.description: HashiCorp's MCP server giving agents access to Terraform Registry data and, where configured, workspace operations.

entities.name: kagent
entities.description: Open-source framework for running AI agents inside Kubernetes, with tools for cluster and cloud-native operations.

entities.name: K8sGPT
entities.description: CLI and operator that scans a Kubernetes cluster and explains detected problems in plain language using an LLM backend.

entities.name: DORA State of DevOps / AI-assisted development report
entities.description: Google Cloud's annual research report on software delivery performance and, recently, the effect of AI on delivery.

entities.name: State of Platform Engineering report
entities.description: Recurring survey report published by PlatformEngineering.org.

entities.name: OpenTofu
entities.description: Open-source infrastructure-as-code tool forked from Terraform and compatible with Terraform configurations, governed under the Linux Foundation.

entities.name: Open Policy Agent
entities.description: General-purpose policy engine. Policies written in Rego decide authorization and admission for Kubernetes, APIs, CI and infrastructure changes.

entities.name: Argo Rollouts
entities.description: Kubernetes controller for progressive delivery: blue-green and canary rollouts with automated analysis and rollback.

entities.name: Argo Workflows
entities.description: Kubernetes-native workflow engine that runs jobs and pipelines as graphs of containers.

entities.name: Tekton
entities.description: Kubernetes-native framework for building CI/CD pipelines from reusable tasks.

entities.name: Jenkins
entities.description: Long-running open-source automation server for CI/CD, extended through a large plugin ecosystem. Usually self-hosted.

entities.name: GitHub Actions
entities.description: GitHub's built-in CI/CD and workflow automation, with hosted or self-hosted runners.

entities.name: Salesforce Platform
entities.description: Salesforce's platform-as-a-service: custom applications built on its CRM data model, with integration APIs into the rest of the enterprise.

entities.name: Salesforce CLI
entities.description: Command-line tool for Salesforce development and delivery: source tracking, scratch orgs, packaging and metadata deploys. The usual backbone of Salesforce CI/CD.

entities.name: Salesforce DX MCP Server
entities.description: Salesforce's MCP server that exposes Salesforce DX operations to AI agents.

entities.name: Agentforce
entities.description: Salesforce's platform for building and running AI agents that act on Salesforce data and workflows.

entities.name: Amazon EKS
entities.description: AWS's managed Kubernetes service.

entities.name: AWS DevOps Agent
entities.description: AWS's AI agent for incident investigation and operational tasks in AWS environments.

entities.name: ServiceNow Now Platform
entities.description: ServiceNow's platform for building workflow applications on a shared data model spanning IT, HR and customer service, with App Engine for low-code apps and scoped apps for custom code.

entities.name: ServiceNow SDK
entities.description: ServiceNow's SDK and CLI for source-driven development: define applications in code, build and deploy them from a local repository.

entities.name: Microsoft Power Platform
entities.description: Microsoft's low-code platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages and Copilot Studio on the Dataverse data model, with connectors into Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365 and other enterprise systems.

entities.name: Power Platform Build Tools
entities.description: Microsoft's Azure DevOps tasks and GitHub Actions for Power Platform ALM: exporting, checking, packing and deploying solutions between environments.

entities.name: SAP Business Technology Platform
entities.description: SAP's platform for extending S/4HANA and SuccessFactors, with Cloud Foundry and Kyma (SAP-managed Kubernetes) runtimes.

entities.name: Terraform Provider for SAP BTP
entities.description: SAP's Terraform provider for BTP: global accounts, subaccounts, entitlements and service instances managed as code.

alternatives.note: Same Backstage model; Roadie trades control and cost for not operating it yourself.
Port is configured rather than coded; Backstage gives full control at the price of a team to run it.
Cortex leads with scorecards and ownership; Backstage leads with an extensible portal you build.
OpsLevel leads with catalog maturity and campaigns; Backstage leads with an extensible portal you build.
Both are scorecard-first managed portals; compare on campaign tooling, data model and price per seat.
Both are CNCF-graduated GitOps engines; Argo CD ships a UI and app-centric model, Flux is a lighter controller toolkit.
K8sGPT diagnoses and explains; kagent is a framework for agents that act. Different blast radius.
Jenkins is self-hosted and plugin-extended, so you own upgrades and plugin risk; GitHub Actions is hosted and tied to GitHub repositories.
Tekton runs pipelines as Kubernetes resources; Jenkins runs them on its own controller and agents.
Kyverno writes policies as Kubernetes YAML; OPA uses Rego and also covers decisions outside Kubernetes.
Argo Rollouts handles canary and blue-green steps; Flux pairs with Flagger for the same job.
Both are system-of-record platforms you build on; Salesforce starts from customer data, ServiceNow from IT, HR and service workflows.
Power Platform is lower-code and rides on Microsoft 365 and Dynamics; Salesforce carries a deeper CRM data model and a heavier custom-code tier.
ServiceNow suits enterprise workflow on its own data model; Power Platform suits process apps across Microsoft 365, with broader connectors.
BTP's Kyma runtime is SAP-managed Kubernetes inside the SAP estate; EKS is general-purpose managed Kubernetes.
